{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Terra Velasquez — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Terra Velasquez]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Terra Velasquez]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Terra Velasquez]]'s Engineer services in Shou Xing.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Terra Velasquez is discovered through [[Jude Navarro]].
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement after receiving Terra's referral from [[Jude Navarro]].
* Unlock [[Jude Navarro]].
* Provide Jude with '''5 Genetic Repair Meds''' to discover Terra Velasquez.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Covert Theft and Covert Heist Missions'''
Both qualifying mission types involve stealing a specified target from a settlement while avoiding the conditions that would fail the covert objective.

=== Covert Theft ===

A Covert Theft mission generally requires stealing an item from settlement storage.

The mission's covert condition means the settlement alarm must not be successfully raised during the operation.

=== Covert Heist ===

A Covert Heist generally requires stealing material from a secured sample containment unit.

Sample containment units require time to open and can trigger settlement alarms, making the settlement's alarm system particularly important during these missions.

{{Tip|Locating and disabling the '''Settlement Alarm System''' before performing the actual theft can greatly reduce the risk of failing a covert mission once illegal activity begins.}}

See Covert Missions, Settlement Infiltration, and Settlement Alarm System for the full stealth workflow.

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Unlock [[Jude Navarro]].
# Provide Jude with '''5 Genetic Repair Meds''' to discover Terra Velasquez.
# Accept missions explicitly identified as '''Covert Theft''' or '''Covert Heist'''.
# Successfully complete a total of '''6''' qualifying missions.
# Travel to '''Rascal's Choice''' on '''Shou Xing 1'''.
# Access Terra Velasquez's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Terra Velasquez]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
